headline: Galy cultured cocoa hits US; Oobli-Cosun sugar replacer; FDA salt-substitute rule for breads
summary: Galy is taking cell-cultured cocoa to US consumers (WunderHaus) and professional kitchens, a direct partnership target and competitive threat for Belcolade.
Oobli and Cosun launched a sweet-protein sugar replacer for chocolate, a benchmark and potential partner for sugar-reduced Belcolade lines and fillings.
FDA will allow salt substitutes in 139 standardized foods, including breads and rolls, from December 14, 2026, a sell-in moment for Puratos sodium-reduction solutions.

US policy pressure on ultra-processed foods and GRAS keeps building even as MAHA advocate Calley Means resigns, so customers will want clean-label reformulation options and Puratos should audit its GRAS dossiers.
Grupo Bimbo and other NA bakers are adding fibre and protein, and a new sesame recall on WinCo rolls is a reminder that allergen control remains a live customer concern.

items.title: Revolutionizing egg-free baking: alkaline-extracted plant proteins as sustainable modifiers of muffin structure and palatability
items.summary: Indian researchers use alkaline-extracted plant proteins to replace egg in muffins and assess structure and palatability.
items.why: Egg-free muffin data supports Patisserie's egg-replacement cake mixes; worth benchmarking against Puratos egg-reduction solutions.

items.title: Dry fractionation of chickpea flour: balancing protein enrichment, coproduct functionality and environmental sustainability
items.summary: Aarhus University, NTUA and Hosokawa Alpine assess dry fractionation of chickpea flour into protein-rich fractions and coproducts, weighing functionality and environmental impact.
items.why: Dry-fractionated pulse protein is a lower-footprint route to protein-enriched bread and mixes; Hosokawa Alpine is a possible process partner for Bakery.

items.title: WinCo Recalls Hoagie Rolls in Seven Western States Over Undeclared Sesame, With Best-By Dates Through November 3
items.summary: WinCo is recalling hoagie rolls in seven western US states because of undeclared sesame, with best-by dates through November 3.
items.why: Another sesame-labelling recall in US rolls is a reminder for bakery customers to check sesame cross-contact and labelling since sesame became a major US allergen; Puratos can support with allergen-controlled ingredients.

items.title: Millet fermentations: a review on microorganisms, fermentation parameters, nutrients bio-utilization, and future prospects
items.summary: Jiangsu and Shanghai Jiao Tong universities review microorganisms, parameters and nutrient effects of millet fermentations.
items.why: Millet fermentation know-how supports ancient-grain and gluten-free sourdough ideas for Sapore.

items.title: WinCo Foods LLC Hoagie Rolls Recall: Idaho’s WinCo Foods LLC Launches Voluntary Recall for Hoagie Rolls Over Undisclosed Sesame Allergen – Check How to Return
items.summary: WinCo Foods voluntarily recalls hoagie rolls over undeclared sesame.
items.why: Sesame allergen recalls in bakery keep allergen control high on US customers' agenda; a prompt to review sesame labelling support.

items.title: Calley Means, a Key MAHA Advocate, Resigns as a Top RFK Jr. Adviser
items.summary: Calley Means, a key MAHA advocate and adviser to HHS Secretary RFK Jr., resigns.
items.why: Losing a leading MAHA voice could slow or reshape the ultra-processed food definition and dye/additive push that bakery and confectionery customers are preparing for; keep reformulation plans but watch the timeline.
